convention: Expected lines = every executed line that the variable's final value depends on, through data (a value it read) or control (the if/for/while/call that made a needed line run). The first line of a called function (Python def, C/C++ signature) counts when the call is in the slice. Lines that never ran are never included. The question is asked at the end of the program, about a variable of the main program.
